title: Analytic: frustrated total internal reflection across a vacuum gap (Bloch FDTD, s and p)
description:
A plane-wave pulse travels in glass (n = 1.5) at 60 deg, beyond the critical angle 41.8 deg, toward a vacuum gap of width d followed by glass again; once in E_z (physics 'em_s', s-polarised) and once in H_z (physics 'em_p', p-polarised). The strip is y-periodic with Bloch wave vector ky = n k0 sin(60 deg) at lambda0 = 1 um (ky = 1.30 k0 > k0: evanescent in the gap), so the vertical line source in the glass launches the wave at 60 deg; glass fills both sides into the CPML. The sweep runs d over 0.05-0.5 um.
Analytic (symmetric barrier): q = n k0 cos(theta) in the glass, kappa = k0 sqrt(n^2 sin^2(theta) - 1) in the gap, 1 / T = 1 + ((alpha^2 + kappa^2) / (2 alpha kappa))^2 sinh^2(kappa d) with alpha = q (s) or q / n^2 (p) (d = 0.3 um: T_s 0.160, T_p 0.084; p tunnels less); incident power per period in the glass P_s = A^2 n Ly / (2 eta0 cos(theta)) (an E_z sheet radiates A / cos(theta)), P_p = A^2 n Ly cos(theta) / (2 eta0) (an in-plane sheet radiates |E| = A).
Sweep tab: derived T_s, T_p (power_per_cw of the flux line behind the gap at lambda0 / P) vs d_gap with the dashed references (exponential tunnelling decay ~exp(-2 kappa d) beyond d ~ 1 / kappa = 0.19 um).
Spectra tab: em_s.trans / em_p.trans quantity power_per_cw vs the dashed P(lambda) T(lambda): at fixed ky the angle, kappa and P change across the 0.95-1.05 um band (grazing cutoff in the glass at 1.155 um).
Measured agreement (CPU run): T_s within 0.3 %, T_p within 0.5 % over the sweep. spectrum_s is scored against the band range (ptp) of P_s T_s, and at d = 0.2 um the rise of P_s(lambda) ~ 1 / cos(theta) and the fall of T_s(lambda) cancel to first order (ptp ~2 % of the value), so a 0.17 % deviation reads as 0.087: hence its tolerance 0.15.

parameters.name: n_glass
parameters.description: refractive index of the glass on both sides of the gap

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: source centre wavelength = wavelength of the derived values

parameters.name: theta_deg
parameters.description: incidence angle in the glass at lambda0 [deg] (critical angle 41.8 deg)

parameters.name: th
parameters.description: incidence angle [rad]

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber k0 at lambda0 [1/m]

parameters.name: ky
parameters.description: Bloch wave vector along y [rad/m] (1.30 k0)

parameters.name: d_gap
parameters.description: vacuum gap width (swept 0.05-0.5 um; whole cells)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain length (cpml on both x faces, glass into both)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: periodic y period (10 cells; only the zeroth diffraction order)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (67 cells per glass wavelength)

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: line source x (cell centre), in the glass

parameters.name: x_gap
parameters.description: gap front face (a cell edge)

parameters.name: x_flux
parameters.description: transmitted flux line x (cell centre), in the glass behind the gap

parameters.name: A_src
parameters.description: line source amplitude [V/m] (normal-incidence calibration in the glass)

parameters.name: bw
parameters.description: relative pulse bandwidth: narrow, so the spectrum is negligible at the grazing cutoff 2 pi n / ky (1.155 um)

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration (pulse 2 t0 ~ 190 fs plus the slow x transit c cos(theta) / n)

parameters.name: eta0
parameters.description: vacuum impedance [Ohm]

parameters.name: cos_i
parameters.description: cos of the incidence angle in the glass

parameters.name: q_glass
parameters.description: normal wavenumber in the glass [1/m]

parameters.name: kappa
parameters.description: decay constant in the gap [1/m]

parameters.name: F_s
parameters.description: s barrier factor (alpha = q)

parameters.name: F_p
parameters.description: p barrier factor (alpha = q / n^2)

parameters.name: T_s_ref
parameters.description: analytic s power transmission

parameters.name: T_p_ref
parameters.description: analytic p power transmission

parameters.name: P_s
parameters.description: incident E_z power per period [W/m] toward +x

parameters.name: P_p
parameters.description: incident H_z power per period [W/m] toward +x
